verdict.rationale: Square documents Webhooks (square-docs-12), which push event notifications that a developer's own code can use to trigger actions. The evidence is only a doc title, though, and shows no built-in rule definition or automation engine, so the user must build the trigger-to-action logic themselves. Missing for 10: a native rule/automation builder, documented event types and trigger conditions, configurable automatic actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
